page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but weaker multi-core scaling. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the average tier, supported by hardware acceleration flags such as AVX-512 and AES cryptography extensions. However, multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench is categorized as weak, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is poor. Memory bandwidth tests also show weak performance, with uncached large-block reads and writes measuring 30.0 GB/sec and 25.02 GB/sec respectively.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers a stable resource profile for general-purpose workloads. However, the lack of local storage and the weaker multi-threaded and memory bandwidth benchmarks suggest it is less suited for intensive database operations or high-throughput data processing. It is best utilized for workloads that rely on steady single-core performance, such as lightweight web serving, basic text processing, and moderate application hosting.
